prompts.beetle_charge: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 32x32 raster action icon for Space Station 13 xenomorph HUD. Primary request: a beautifully readable beetle minion ramming charge icon, ONE standalone square sprite on genuine transparent background. Show a small dark chitinous beetle in three-quarter side profile launching to the right with lowered armored head, two clear curved horns and three broad amber/tan motion strokes behind it. Match the old TG xenomorph action palette reference: muted brown, near-black plum chitin, bone highlights and rusty orange action strokes. Strong coherent silhouette, hand-pixelled low-resolution appearance, pixel clusters and deliberate outlines, readable after nearest-neighbor reduction to 30x30. No neon purple or green, no UI frame, no lettering, no multiple tiles, no gradients, no background.
prompts.rally: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 32x32 raster action icon for Space Station 13 xenomorph HUD. Primary request: one readable alien hive rally point icon, ONE standalone square sprite on genuine transparent background. A dark chitin spike with a small organic fleshy rust-colored pennant, surrounded by a thin ivory ground-target ring and a curved brown directional arrow. Match old TG xenomorph action art: near-black brown/plum chitin, muted bone highlights, rusty red/brown and pale tan. The spike/flag and ring must remain distinct at 30x30, strong hand-pixelled outline and deliberate pixel clusters. No neon, no lettering, no UI frame, no multiple tiles, no background.
prompts.generator_extractor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new 64x64-native pixel-art organic hive structure for Space Station 13, occupying 2x2 tiles. Input image 1 (StarCraft extractor concept) is broad SHAPE/CONCEPT REFERENCE, not an edit target and not art to copy; image 2 (local xenomorph castes) is the PALETTE/MATERIAL reference. Primary request: design an ORIGINAL xenomorph biomass organ: a low open ACID BASIN embedded in a broad mound of living roots, with three or four irregular curved chitin spines rising around its rim. Central luminous dull acid-green liquid cavity clearly visible; pores below its rim vent vapor in-game. Two inflated wine-maroon fleshy side sacs feed into the basin through organic veins. The broad hollow silhouette and breathing acid bowl should REMOTELY evoke the supplied extractor concept while using original anatomy and proportions. It must NOT look like a conventional generator, turbine, engine, industrial building or machine. Pure black blue-gray chitin with cool gray highlights and muted maroon flesh, matching the local caste sheet; green ONLY in the central acid pool, no saturated purple casing. No skull/head shape. Top-down 3/4 SS13 orthographic view, flat stable footprint and strong readable 64x64 hand-pixel-art clusters; not painterly, no fine noisy texture. One static standalone complete sprite, centered with 5% transparent margins, no smoke painted into the sprite (smoke will be animated separately), no floor, ground shadow, text, labels, UI frame, nameplate, logo or multiple panels. Genuine transparent background.

references.extractor: User-provided StarCraft extractor concept screenshot; reference only, not redistributed.
